name: Aadhaar / UIDAI Compliance Audit Services
description: Comprehensive Aadhaar and UIDAI compliance audit services for AUA, KUA, Sub-AUA, Sub-KUA and Face Authentication entities to ensure adherence to UIDAI security, operational, and data protection guidelines.

acceptedAnswer.text: Aadhaar/UIDAI Audit is a compliance audit conducted for AUAs, KUAs, Sub-AUAs, Sub-KUAs, and Face Authentication entities to ensure adherence to UIDAI security and operational guidelines.

mainEntity.name: Who is required to undergo the audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Banks, NBFCs, fintech companies, telecom operators, government agencies, and Sub-AUA or Sub-KUA entities are required to undergo the audit.

mainEntity.name: Does the audit include Face Authentication systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, all biometric systems including Face Authentication solutions are assessed for security controls and UIDAI compliance.
Yes, audits can be conducted remotely with secure system access and submission of required documentation.
Deliverables include a detailed audit report, executive summary, gap analysis, risk register, remediation roadmap, and supporting evidence documentation.
Yes, ISECURION provides remediation guidance, verification support, and re-audit assistance.
Yes, UIDAI mandates compliance audits for all AUA, KUA, Sub-AUA, Sub-KUA, and authentication service providers.

mainEntity.name: How long does the audit take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The audit duration depends on organizational size, system complexity, and the number of Aadhaar-enabled applications.

mainEntity.name: Does the audit improve operational security?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the audit strengthens authentication mechanisms, monitoring controls, logging, and incident response capabilities.
Yes, Sub-AUAs, Sub-KUAs, and integration or technology partners are included in the audit scope.
Yes, UIDAI mandates encryption of Aadhaar data both at rest and in transit.

mainEntity.name: Does the audit assess logs and monitoring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, tamper-proof audit logs and real-time monitoring mechanisms are thoroughly reviewed.
Yes, fingerprint and Face Authentication biometric systems are validated as part of the audit.

mainEntity.name: Can multiple entities be audited together?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, scalable audit frameworks allow concurrent assessment of multiple entities and systems.
ISECURION combines deep UIDAI regulatory expertise with strong cybersecurity capabilities to deliver practical, audit-ready, and resilient Aadhaar compliance.
